title: My aviation playground is live

Rewrite this in your own words, or delete it.

title: A320 flight control computers: 2 + 3 + 2
body: The A320 has seven flight control computers in total: two ELACs, three SECs and two FACs.
The FACs handle yaw damping, turn coordination and rudder travel limiting, while the FCDCs collect data from the ELACs and SECs for the displays and maintenance system.

title: File names are case-sensitive online
body: Windows treats Image.JPG and image.jpg as the same file, but GitHub's servers don't. A picture can work on my computer and break on the live site.
Rule I follow now: lowercase file names with hyphens, and no spaces.
